Name: Range Display
Author: CatCattyCat
Description:
[size=6]Range Display[/size]

This mod displays the range of the sprinklers, scarecrows, bee houses, and junimo huts that you have. It works anywhere you can place sprinklers, scarecrows, or bee houses (including the greenhouse).

[size=6]Features:[/size]
Press the activation key (default f2) to switch through showing scarecrows, then sprinklers, then junimo huts, then bee houses, then all at once, then none.

Press the modifier key (default left control) and hover over an item in the world (sprinkler, scarecrow, etc) to see the range of just that item.

The range of items that you hold (sprinklers, scarecrow, bee house, etc) will be displayed at your mouse cursor while you're placing them.

You can specify multiple keys to activate for each option n a comma separated list. For example, 'leftcontrol,rightcontrol' for modifier key lets you use either of your control keys.

Note: Both the item hovering range display and item holding range display can be disabled, see the config file.

[size=6][b]**Version 2.0 is completely new. When upgrading delete your Sprinkler Range folder or it won't load. You'll need to reset your key bindings (sorry :( )**[/b][/size]
[size=5][b]New in version 2.0[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Complete re-write of the entire mod. Tiles are no longer outlines and always filled in.
[*]Added junimo hut range!
[*]Added item hovering and holding!
[/list]
[size=4][b]Now works with Better Sprinklers and Simple Sprinkler (v2.3.0)!
[b]Now works with Prismatic Sprinklers (v2.6.0)![/b][/b][/size]

Requires SMAPI.

Place the 'Range Display' folder in the Mods folder inside of the Stardew Valley folder.
